Shapiro Capital Management Increases Stake in Hanesbrands (HBI); Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) Holding Maintained by Elizabeth Park Capital Advisors Ltd
May 7, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Fred Cummings increased its stake in Huntington Bancshares Inc (HBAN) by 11.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Elizabeth Park Capital Advisors Ltd bought 98,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.01% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Fred Cummings held 967,196 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.08M, up from 869,196 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Elizabeth Park Capital Advisors Ltd who had been investing in Huntington Bancshares Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.20B market cap company. The stock increased 1.66% or $0.24 $14.7. About 5.92 million shares traded. Huntington Bancshares Incorporated (NASDAQ:HBAN) has risen 14.67% uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.12% the S&P500.
Shapiro Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Hanesbrands Inc. (HBI) by 50.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shapiro Capital Management Llc bought 1.59M shares as the company’s stock declined 7.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 4.76M shares of the clothing and shoe and accessory stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $99.55 billion, up from 3.17 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shapiro Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Hanesbrands Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.82% or $0.3 $16.81. About 8.32M shares traded or 14.48% up from the average. Hanesbrands Inc. (NYSE:HBI) has declined 8.16% downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.71% the S&P500.
Shapiro Capital Management Llc, which manages about $4.00 billion and $4568.12 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE:GNRC) by 548,950 shares to 685,640 shares, valued at $33.95 billion in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Versum Materials Inc. by 1.97M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 2.15 million shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL).
